cimgroup-cimgroup:lever:613a7f0d-d982-44.title: Senior Analyst, Cost Allocations
cimgroup-cimgroup:lever:613a7f0d-d982-44.description: ABOUT CIM GROUP: CIM is a community-focused real estate and infrastructure owner, operator, lender, and developer. Our team of experts works together to identify and create value in real assets, benefiting the communities in which we invest. Back in 1994, our three founders focused on projects in Southern California neighborhoods. Today, we are a diverse team of 900+ employees with projects across the Americas. Our projects have delivered jobs; created comfortable places to live, work, and relax; and provided necessary and sustainable infrastructure. Our focus on enhancing communities is unwavering, and we strive to make an even greater impact in the years to come. Join us and make an impact today! POSITION PURPOSE: The Senior Analyst, Cost Allocations serves as a strategic partner and analytical leader driving visibility, accountability, and data‑driven decision‑making across CIM. This role sits at the intersection of finance, technology, and operations, shaping how the organization understands and deploys its corporate resources. Acting as an architect and steward of CIM’s cost allocation strategy, the Manager partners closely with IT, Accounting, Finance, Legal, and Compliance to design, refine, and operationalize a best‑in‑class allocation framework. This work supports enterprise planning, informs leadership decisions, and ensures the transparency required for stakeholders to understand the services, systems, and support activities driving their allocated costs. The ideal candidate is equal parts financial strategist, data translator, and operational problem solver—someone who thrives on simplifying complexity and influencing organizational outcomes.
responsibilities: Lead the end-to-end allocation of enterprise cost pools, ensuring models, methodologies, and processes accurately reflect business activities and evolving strategic priorities.
Serve as the Company’s subject matter expert on allocation strategy, providing proactive guidance, thought partnership, and clear communications to stakeholders across all business units.
Analyze and synthesize complex data sets—financial, operational, and technological—to deliver actionable insights for senior leadership, department heads, and fund teams.
Collaborate with IT and data engineering teams to enhance system integrations, develop scalable tools, improve data quality, and validate allocation logic within technology solutions.
Produce compelling visualizations and reporting that highlight trends, cost drivers, efficiency opportunities, and value delivered across the organization.
Document business processes, partner with internal auditors, and ensure robust controls supporting accuracy, compliance, and enterprise‑level integrity.
qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
4+ years of progressive experience in accounting, finance, audit, fund administration, or cost allocation environments.
Audit or fund compliance experience strongly preferred, including:
Reviewing and interpreting fund governing documents.
Applying professional judgment to ambiguous or principles‑based documentation.
Demonstrated ownership of a recurring or enterprise‑critical process, such as:
Corporate or departmental allocation cycles.
Fund billing processes.
Financial close workflows.
A cross‑functional or systems‑supported finance process.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills and experience influencing stakeholders across all levels of an organization.
Proficiency with BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Domo) supporting scalable analytical solutions.
A strategic thinker who enjoys untangling complexity and influencing decisions across a dynamic, multi‑stakeholder environment.
Highly analytical, yet also comfortable translating technical or data‑heavy concepts into compelling narratives.
Experience working closely with technology teams, including articulating business requirements, validating system outputs, and contributing to data‑driven product enhancements.
Naturally curious, detail‑oriented, and motivated to understand how processes, systems, and teams connect across the enterprise.
Able to balance recurring workflows with project‑based initiatives while managing deadlines effectively in a fast‑paced environment.
Comfortable working independently, taking ownership, and proactively identifying areas where clarity, improvement, or strategic insight is needed.

databricksventures-replit-com:ashbyhq:ca.description: Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation. ABOUT THE ROLE: Join our Site Reliability Engineering team and help ensure the reliability, scalability, and performance of Replit's infrastructure that serves millions of developers worldwide. As a Site Reliability Engineer, you will bridge the gap between development and operations, implementing automation and establishing best practices that enable our platform to scale efficiently while maintaining high availability. We are seeking SREs who are passionate about building and maintaining resilient systems at scale. Your mission will be to design and implement robust monitoring solutions, automate operational tasks, and continuously improve our infrastructure's reliability and performance. YOU WILL: - Design and Implement Observability Solutions: Develop comprehensive monitoring and alerting systems using modern observability tools. Create dashboards and metrics that provide real-time visibility into system health and performance. Implement logging strategies that enable quick problem identification and resolution. - Drive Automation and Infrastructure as Code: Architect and implement infrastructure automation solutions using tools like Terraform, Ansible, or Pulumi. Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines that enable reliable and consistent deployments. Create self-healing systems that can automatically respond to common failure scenarios. - Establish SLOs and SLIs: Work with product and engineering teams to define and implement Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and Service Level Indicators (SLIs). Build systems to track and report on these metrics, ensuring we maintain high reliability standards while balancing innovation speed. - Incident Management and Response: Lead incident response efforts, conducting thorough post-mortems, and implementing improvements to prevent future occurrences. Develop and maintain runbooks for critical services. Build tools and processes that reduce Mean Time To Recovery (MTTR). - Performance Optimization: Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks across our infrastructure. Implement capacity planning strategies and optimize resource utilization. Work on reducing latency and improving system efficiency across global regions. REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: - 4-8 years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering or similar roles (DevOps, Systems Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering) - Strong programming skills in languages commonly used for automation (Python, Go, or similar) - Deep understanding of distributed systems - Experience with container orchestration platforms (Kubernetes) and cloud-native technologies - Proven track record of implementing and maintaining monitoring/observability solutions - Strong incident management skills with experience leading incident response - Experience with infrastructure as code and configuration management tools BONUS POINTS: - Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services and tools - Knowledge of modern observability platforms (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, etc.) WHAT WE VALUE: - Problem-solving mindset: Ability to approach complex operational challenges systematically and devise effective solutions - Self-directed and autonomous: Capable of working independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams - Strong communication skills: Ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences - Continuous learning: Passion for staying current with industry best practices and new technologies - Focus on automation: Strong belief in automating repetitive tasks and building self-healing systems Full-Time Employee Benefits Include: 💰 Competitive Salary & Equity 💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only) ⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance 🩼 Short

hophr-hophr:lever:9e92ee57-64d5-493d-8f7.description: Draup is a Series A-funded agentic AI company building the intelligence layer for how global enterprises make workforce and go-to-market decisions. We work with 250+ enterprise clients — including 5 of the Fortune 10 — processing 1B+ job descriptions, 850M+ professional profiles, and signals from 100+ labor databases. We are now building our Silicon Valley engineering team — a small, senior group focused on next-generation AI research and product. Location: San Francisco, SoMa — minimum 4 days per week in-office. What you'll do • Build and maintain production-grade LLM pipelines and agentic workflows. • Design and optimize RAG architectures using vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS, Weaviate) at scale. • Implement agentic systems using LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or equivalent: tool use, multi-agent coordination, and reasoning loops. • Own prompt engineering, model versioning, evaluation (RAGAS, DeepEval), and LLMOps instrumentation. • Integrate AI features into large-scale data pipelines; maintain observability and guardrails in production. What we require • BS/MS in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or related field. • 3–5 years of AI/ML engineering; minimum 2 years building LLM-powered systems shipped to production. • Strong Python; PyTorch or Hugging Face Transformers; AWS or GCP; Docker/Kubernetes. • Portfolio of shipped AI work required — agentic pipelines, RAG systems, or fine-tuned models. • No visa sponsorship. Must be authorized to work in the US without current or future employer sponsorship.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:2c2380a3-85c6-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Software Engineer based in Canada. This is a hands-on senior engineering role focused on building and operating high-performance, real-time software systems for next-generation transportation infrastructure. You will work at the core of a platform that combines roadway technology, sensors, data infrastructure, and AI-enabled analytics to deliver real-time operational insights. The role offers broad ownership across system design, algorithm development, data processing, deployment, and ongoing operations. You will develop production-grade services and algorithms primarily in C++, while also working with Go, Python, cloud infrastructure, and modern deployment technologies. A key part of the role involves transforming historic and simulated data into rigorous testing and validation workflows before systems reach live environments. You will work independently in an environment that values initiative, thoughtful use of AI-assisted development tools, strong engineering judgment, and end-to-end ownership. This is an opportunity to contribute to complex systems that can directly improve the safety, efficiency, and intelligence of modern transportation networks. Translate high-level and sometimes ambiguous requirements into robust system designs, technical solutions, and production-ready implementations. Own features and systems throughout their complete lifecycle, from initial development and testing through production deployment, monitoring, and ongoing operations and maintenance. Design, build, tune, and operate high-throughput, low-latency services using C++, Go, and Python. Develop and optimize production-facing algorithms for tracking, inference, sensor fusion, and other real-time intelligence use cases. Use historic and simulated datasets to iterate, test, tune, and rigorously validate algorithms and system behavior before live deployment. Design and implement high-performance inter-application communication mechanisms and robust data interfaces for real-time data exchange. Optimize data structures, Protobuf serialization, Redis Streams, and related technologies for real-time processing workloads. Architect and manage data pipelines covering sensor ingestion, transformation, storage, processing, and downstream delivery. Build REST APIs and integrate internal and external services to support reliable platform functionality. Implement comprehensive observability across performance-critical applications, including monitoring, logging, alerting, and operational diagnostics. Deploy and operate containerized services on Kubernetes using technologies such as Argo and Helm within GCP environments. Develop and maintain technical documentation, system documentation, operational runbooks, and integration specifications. Collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders and clearly communicate architectural decisions and trade-offs. Contribute to a high-trust engineering culture where initiative, experimentation, collaboration, and strong technical ideas are encouraged. Requirements 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, ideally as a versatile generalist with a strong backend and systems focus. Deep experience designing, building, tuning, and operating real-time systems. Strong proficiency in C++, with demonstrated experience implementing high-performance, low-latency algorithms in production environments. Proficiency in Python for prototyping, experimentation, numerical computing, or algorithm development. Demonstrated ability to use historic and simulated data to rapidly iterate on algorithms, validate system behavior, and improve production logic. Strong understanding of data interfaces, including inter-process communication, high-speed messaging protocols, and strict, reliable interfaces between applications. jobgether-jobgether:lever:2f583e42-193a-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a ServiceNow Business Consultant based in India. This role sits at the intersection of business process consulting, ServiceNow ITSM, and delivery management. You will bring structure to a complex backlog, transforming accumulated stories, enhancements, and incidents into prioritized, actionable work. The role combines requirements engineering with process improvement, stakeholder management, and delivery governance. You will work closely with client process owners, operational leaders, and platform architects to create predictable execution and measurable outcomes. A key part of the role is establishing meaningful delivery metrics and using them to communicate progress clearly to leadership. This is an opportunity for an experienced ServiceNow professional to become a trusted advisor while directly improving ITSM processes and delivery performance. Take ownership of the existing ITSM backlog by inventorying, classifying, and prioritizing work based on size, age, module, business impact, and urgency, while establishing an initial burn-down baseline. Transform raw business demand into clear, well-formed, estimable user stories with defined acceptance criteria and implementation-ready requirements. Lead backlog refinement sessions with client process owners and ensure development teams have a consistent, prioritized pipeline of actionable work. Assess current-state ITSM processes, identify operational gaps, and define measurable improvements that can be delivered alongside backlog execution. Establish and publish delivery metrics including sprint velocity, throughput, commitment reliability, defect escape rate, and other quality indicators. Own the underlying data used for weekly client status reporting and translate delivery performance into clear, credible narratives for stakeholders and leadership. Design, coordinate, and manage the User Acceptance Testing (UAT) process with client stakeholders, ensuring releases meet agreed requirements and quality expectations. Protect releases from scope gaps, unclear requirements, and quality surprises by maintaining strong requirements and validation practices. Partner closely with the client's operational leadership and platform architecture stakeholders to understand priorities, resolve issues, and maintain alignment. Build a strong trusted-advisor relationship through effective communication, facilitation, transparency, and consistent delivery. Requirements 9–12 years of relevant professional experience, including at least 6 years in ServiceNow business analysis, business process consulting, or related ITSM roles. Demonstrated experience managing large-scale enterprise ITSM backlogs, including intake models, prioritization frameworks, backlog governance, and refinement processes. Strong working knowledge of the ServiceNow ITSM data model and configuration concepts, with the ability to translate business requirements into implementable technical stories. ITIL v4 Foundation certification or higher is required; ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification is preferred. Proven experience defining and monitoring delivery metrics such as velocity, throughput, commitment reliability, and defect escape rates. Ability to present operational and delivery metrics clearly to client leadership and translate data into actionable recommendations. Excellent facilitation, stakeholder management, written communication, and requirements documentation skills. Strong ability to collaborate with process owners, developers, architects, operational leaders, and consulting stakeholders. Experience in regulated industries such as medical devices, pharmaceuticals, or healthcare is an advantage. Our partner is looking for a Regional Creative Lead based in Switzerland. As Regional Creative Lead, you will shape the creative presence of a globally recognized entertainment brand across North America, EMEA, and LATAM. You’ll combine creative leadership with hands-on production, turning strategic insights into compelling integrated campaigns. Working closely with regional marketing leads, global brand and creative teams, and agency partners, you’ll establish a consistent creative standard while adapting work to local cultures and audiences. You’ll oversee concepts from initial insight through final execution and personally create graphics, video, social, and event assets when needed. The role offers significant visibility and influence, including opportunities to present creative direction to senior leadership. Success will mean building a cohesive regional identity that feels globally recognizable while remaining culturally relevant in every market.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:d353297f-2d1d-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Business Operations Manager based in Ireland. As Business Operations Manager, you’ll play a central role in ensuring commercial operations run smoothly across the EMEA region. You’ll act as the operational bridge between Commercial, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, HQ Operations, and external partners. Your scope will span the full commercial lifecycle, from quotations and orders through provisioning, invoicing, renewals, and partner operations. This is an independent, hands-on role where you’ll own issues, coordinate stakeholders, and drive solutions rather than simply provide administrative support. You’ll help identify operational bottlenecks and turn recurring challenges into scalable, standardized processes. Working in a fast-growing healthcare technology environment, you’ll have meaningful exposure to international markets and cross-functional initiatives. The role offers an opportunity to make a tangible impact on operational efficiency while helping support continued expansion across EMEA. Manage quotations and orders by preparing quotes and order forms, reviewing purchase orders, coordinating approvals, and ensuring accurate handovers between Commercial and operational teams. Coordinate order processing and license provisioning, ensuring customer and partner information is complete and resolving operational blockers efficiently. Support invoicing and accounts receivable activities by ensuring invoice readiness, coordinating with Finance, monitoring invoice status and overdue receivables, and resolving billing or documentation issues. Manage renewal operations by maintaining visibility of upcoming renewals, coordinating preparation across relevant teams and partners, and proactively tracking risks and outstanding actions. Support distributor and commercial partner operations, including onboarding, documentation, system access, internal setup, and alignment with operational processes. Coordinate operational requirements for new EMEA markets, working across Commercial, Legal, Finance, Regulatory, Customer Success, and HQ teams. Take ownership of day-to-day commercial operational issues by establishing clear owners and deadlines, coordinating stakeholders, removing bottlenecks, and driving matters through to resolution. Identify recurring operational challenges and develop scalable processes that improve turnaround times, reduce rework, and minimize unnecessary escalations to senior management. Monitor operational performance through metrics such as order-processing times, provisioning lead times, renewal readiness, partner onboarding, AR follow-up, and completion of agreed actions. Requirements: Approximately 4–7 years of experience in Business Operations, Commercial Operations, Order Management, or a related operational role. Experience supporting B2B commercial operations, preferably across multiple countries or international markets. Strong understanding of quotations, purchase orders, invoicing, renewals, and order-to-cash processes. Proven ability to coordinate effectively across Commercial, Finance, Legal, Customer Success, Operations, and external stakeholders. Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive, with a strong sense of ownership and reliable follow-through. Comfortable working independently and taking initiative in a fast-growing, evolving environment where processes may still be developing. Experience using CRM platforms and other business systems to manage operational workflows and information. Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly with stakeholders across different functions and geographies. Experience in SaaS, healthcare, medical devices, healthcare IT, or another technology-driven environment is a plus.
